lines.en: label halloweentwo4:

Or maybe it’s something entirely different.

lines.zh: 怎么说呢，有点好笑。

lines.en: She prefaced her little rant with the prospect of sounding crazy but, in terms of getting a coherent point across, I think she did pretty well.
lines.zh: 她开头还预告自己听起来会像个疯子，但就把连贯的意思表达出来这一点而言，我觉得她做得相当不错。

lines.en: Well, after all of the panicked ranting was out of the way, I mean.
lines.zh: 当然，是在那通慌乱的胡言乱语说完之后。

lines.en: But it’s not like you can blame a girl her age for panicking at the prospect of losing someone.
lines.zh: 但你也不能怪一个她这个年纪的女孩，因为害怕失去某个人而恐慌。

lines.en: Or losing {i}to{/i} someone.
lines.zh: 或者{i}输给{/i}某个人。

lines.en: But, like I said to her, the chances of any fire being rekindled between Niki and I just...
lines.zh: 但就像我对她说的，我和 Niki 之间死灰复燃的可能性……

lines.en: It’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: 不会发生。

lines.en: That fuse burnt out a long time ago.
lines.zh: 那根引线早就烧完了。

lines.en: It’s both fortunate and unfortunate that I was not there to remember it.
lines.zh: 幸也不幸，我不在那里，没能亲眼记住它。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween20
Anyway, back to the party.
lines.zh: 总之，回到派对。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween21
: Jesus Christ.
lines.zh: 天哪。

lines.en: : Praise be.
lines.zh: 赞美主。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween22
: How the fuck did you do that?
lines.zh: 你他妈是怎么做到的？

lines.en: : Do what?
lines.zh: 做到什么？

lines.en: : Just...appear out of thin air.
lines.zh: 就是……凭空出现。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween23
: Air?
lines.zh: 空气？

lines.en: : You know...that invisible stuff floating around that we need to breathe in order to survive.
lines.zh: 你知道的……那种飘在我们周围、我们得靠它呼吸才能活下去的看不见的东西。

lines.en: : There are so many invisible things floating around us at all times. Are they all “air?”
lines.zh: 无时无刻都有那么多看不见的东西飘在我们周围。它们全都是「空气」吗？

lines.en: : Molly! Come over here. I think I found you a drinking partner.
lines.zh: Molly！过来一下。我觉得我给你找了个酒友。

lines.en: : The consumption of unblessed alcohol serves only to cloud the mind. I must remain alert at all times if I ever hope to become all that I am meant to be.
lines.zh: 饮用未经祝福的酒精只会让心智蒙尘。若想成为我注定要成为的一切，我必须时刻保持警觉。

lines.en: : I hereby bless all alcohol or whatever.
lines.zh: 我在此祝福所有酒精之类的。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween24
: Silly Sensei~ You can’t bless anything.
lines.zh: 傻 Sensei~ 你可什么也祝福不了。

lines.en: : Even if you’re among those just inches away from safety, your consciousness is still far too clouded to turn {i}anything{/i} into anything else.
lines.zh: 即便你属于那些离救赎只有咫尺之遥的人，你的意识依旧浑浊不堪，根本无法把{i}任何东西{/i}变成别的什么。

lines.en: : Yasu, where is your guardian?
lines.zh: Yasu，你的监护人在哪儿？

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween25
: Guardian?
lines.zh: 监护人？

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween26
scene norikosadhalloween25
: Whatever do you mean, Sensei?
lines.zh: 你到底是什么意思，Sensei？

lines.en: : Why should I, the purest of the pure and an angel in training need a guardian at all when the very thought of Him guards me from all that is unblessed?
lines.zh: 我既是最纯粹的纯洁者，又是见习天使，光是想到祂就能护我远离一切未受祝福之物，为什么还需要什么监护人？

lines.en: : Wait...Yasu, I think I just-
lines.zh: 等等……Yasu，我觉得我刚——

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween27
scene norikosadhalloween25
: You just what? Doubted the guidance that I have so kindly provided you? Avoided a touch of wisdom from that which remains untouched?
lines.zh: 你刚什么？怀疑我好心提供给你的指引？逃避来自那从未被触及之物的点滴智慧？

lines.en: : No, I just-
lines.zh: 不，我只是——

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween28
scene norikosadhalloween25
: Living a life full of doubt will do nothing but make some decisions much, {i}much{/i} harder than others.
lines.zh: 活在充满怀疑的人生里，只会让某些决定变得比其他决定{i}困难得多{/i}。

lines.en: : Where you rest your head at night. What direction you face when you sleep. All things that matter more than you would imagine in determining even the smallest of details.
lines.zh: 你夜里头枕何处。睡觉时朝向哪个方向。这些事在决定哪怕最微小的细节时，都比你想象的重要得多。

lines.en: : No, Yasu. There is literally a...ghost or something. She’s-
lines.zh: 不，Yasu。这里真的有个……幽灵之类的东西。她是——

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween29
scene norikosadhalloween25
: There are no {i}ghosts{/i}, Sensei. Just the remnants of those who left this plane without accomplishing their goal.
lines.zh: 世上没有{i}幽灵{/i}，Sensei。只有那些未能达成目标就离开此世的人留下的残骸。

lines.en: : Yes. Us normal human beings refer to those as “ghosts.”
lines.zh: 对。我们普通人类管那些叫「幽灵」。

lines.en: : Oh. Then I’m sorry for misunderstanding.
lines.zh: 哦。那是我误会了，抱歉。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween30
: Hi!
lines.zh: 嗨！

lines.en: : Touka! Wherever have you been?
lines.zh: Touka！你到底跑哪儿去了？

lines.en: : Just making some adjustments to my makeup.
lines.zh: 只是去补了补妆。

lines.en: : Is that really you under there?
lines.zh: 这下面真的是你吗？

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween31
: It is! Don’t I look absolutely splendid?!
lines.zh: 是呀！我是不是看起来棒极了？！

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. But it’s not really what I imagined you coming as.
lines.zh: 我是说……是啊。但这真不是我想象中你会扮的样子。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween32
: Heheh! It may come as a surprise, but the truth is that I absolutely adore both Halloween {i}and{/i} horror!
lines.zh: 嘿嘿！可能有点意外，但说实话，我超级喜欢万圣节{i}和{/i}恐怖片的！

lines.en: Doesn’t Sana like horror films too?
lines.zh: Sana 不是也喜欢恐怖片吗？

lines.en: Wait...
lines.zh: 等等……

lines.en: Sana and Touka both need new friends...
lines.zh: Sana 和 Touka 都需要新朋友……

lines.en: I feel like I’m so close to figuring something out, but I can’t put my finger on what it is...
lines.zh: 我感觉自己就快要想明白什么了，可就是说不清那是什么……

lines.en: : Touka? Can I ask you a question?
lines.zh: Touka？我能问你个问题吗？

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween33
: Of course, Yasu! Whatever do you require?
lines.zh: 当然，Yasu！你想要什么？

lines.en: : What is “Halloween?”
lines.zh: 「万圣节」是什么？

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: Sensei！

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween34
: Thank you for always showing up exactly when- oh my god, you are adorable.
lines.zh: 谢谢你每次都恰好在——哦我的天哪，你也太可爱了。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween35
: Nyaa~
lines.zh: 喵~

lines.en: : Please kill me.
lines.zh: 请杀了我。

lines.en: : You should have dressed up too, Io.
lines.zh: 你也该一起扮的，Io。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween36
: Why? Halloween is just one more holiday on the long list of consumer-unfriendly, corporate scams exacted for the sole purpose of profiting off of people who don’t know any better.
lines.zh: 为什么？万圣节不过是又一桩对消费者不友好的企业骗局，存在的唯一目的就是从那些不懂的人身上赚钱。

lines.en: : It’s not only damaging to the lower middle class and anyone else who feels pressured to participate in the name of inclusion, but fundamentally silly and, as far as I’m concerned, a waste of time.
lines.zh: 它不仅伤害中下层阶级，以及任何迫于融入的压力而参与其中的人，而且从根本上就很蠢，在我看来纯粹是浪费时间。

lines.en: : Besides, this isn’t even how we celebrate Halloween in Japan. We should all be getting drunk and sauntering across Shibuya crossing right now.
lines.zh: 再说，这根本不是我们日本庆祝万圣节的方式。我们现在应该都喝得烂醉，然后在涩谷路口晃荡才对。

lines.en: : Molly? I found you another drinking partner.
lines.zh: Molly？我又给你找了个酒友。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween37
: {i}Hisssssss...{/i}
: Don’t worry, Uta. I don’t think any less of you for feeding the money you make off of conning people into multi-billion dollar corporations who don’t care about whether you live or die.
lines.zh: 别担心，Uta。我不会因为你是靠骗人给那些根本不在乎你死活的跨国企业赚钱，就瞧不起你。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween38
: {i}HISSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS!!!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶！！！{/i}

lines.en: : Awwww, I love you too~
lines.zh: 呜哇，我也爱你~

lines.en: : Where can I file adoption paperwork? I suddenly want a pet.
lines.zh: 去哪儿能办收养手续？我突然想养宠物了。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween39
: This kitty’s not up for adoption, nyaa~
lines.zh: 这只小猫不送养哦，喵~

lines.en: : But if you’re still interested in providing a forever home for a cute lil’ fuzzball, may I interest you in our latest kitty over there to your left?
lines.zh: 不过如果你还有兴趣给一只毛茸茸的小家伙一个永远的家，你左手边那只最新款小猫要不要了解一下？

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween40
: To my-
lines.zh: 我的——

lines.en: : Prepare to die, bro.
lines.zh: 受死吧，老兄。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween41
: No, no, Tsunecchi! You’ve gotta add “Nyaa~” to the ends of your sentences. How else will anybody know you’re supposed to be a cat?
lines.zh: 不行不行，Tsunecchi！你说话得加上「喵~」。不然别人怎么知道你是猫？

lines.en: : I apologize. I thought the cat paws, cat tail, and cat whiskers would have given it away.
lines.zh: 我道歉。我以为猫爪、猫尾和猫须已经说明一切了。

lines.en: : I understand now, the error of my ways.
lines.zh: 我现在明白了，我错了。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween42
: Still lookin’ for a little friend to take home and cuddle up with, nyaa?~
lines.zh: 还在找小家伙带回家抱抱吗，喵？~

lines.en: : This one might take a little while to warm up, but she’ll be sittin’ in your lap and purrin’ her heart out before you know it, nyaa!~
lines.zh: 这只可能要花点时间才能亲近人，但不知不觉她就会坐到你腿上，呼噜呼噜地叫个不停，喵！~

lines.en: : I’m in. Ami is going to be so happy that we finally have a cat.
lines.zh: 我要了。Ami 知道我们终于有猫了肯定会特别开心。

lines.en: : Nyaaaaat a chance, bro.
lines.zh: 喵———想都别想，老兄。

lines.en: scene norikosadhalloween43
: Uhh...Almost, Tsunecchi. We’ll get you there.
lines.zh: 呃……快了，Tsunecchi。我们会练好的。

lines.en: : I thought my purrrrrformance was purrrrrrfect, nyaa~
lines.zh: 我以为我的呼噜表呼噜演已经完美无缺了呢，喵~

lines.en: : Oooookay, I’m gonna step outside before I get diabetes.
lines.zh: 好——吧，我得出去一下，不然要得糖尿病了。

lines.en: : Wanna come with me, Sensei?
lines.zh: 要一起吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sure. I’ve already been pulled outside once today. One more time won’t hurt.
lines.zh: 好啊。我今天已经被拉出去一次了。再来一次也无妨。

lines.en: scene black
